skill.name: histolab
skill.description: Guidance for using histolab to process whole slide pathology images, including slide inspection, tissue masks, tile extraction, preprocessing filters, and visualization workflows.
skill.summary: Use histolab workflows to prepare whole slide pathology images for analysis and machine learning.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Whole slide images are large and hard to sample consistently. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through histolab workflows for masks, tile extraction, preprocessing, and quality review.
actual_capabilities: Guides loading and inspecting WSI files with histolab Slide workflows.
Explains tissue mask choices for background filtering and region selection.
Compares RandomTiler, GridTiler, and ScoreTiler extraction strategies.
Outlines preprocessing pipelines for thresholding, morphology, and artifact handling.
Provides visualization steps for thumbnails, masks, tile locations, and quality review.
Helps plan repeatable multi-slide dataset preparation workflows.
limitations: Does not provide medical diagnosis or clinical decision support.
Requires histolab and compatible OpenSlide dependencies to be installed separately.
Workflow quality depends on slide format, stain quality, and available memory.
Does not replace validation by pathology or machine learning domain experts.

use_cases.title: Prepare Training Tiles
use_cases.description: Plan reproducible tile extraction from annotated whole slide images for model development.

use_cases.title: Review Tissue Coverage
use_cases.description: Choose and tune masks to separate tissue regions from background and artifacts.

use_cases.title: Build Slide Processing Workflows
use_cases.description: Design repeatable pipelines for inspecting slides, saving thumbnails, extracting tiles, and checking quality.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a Slide
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner slide loading and metadata review
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me inspect a whole slide image with histolab. I need to load the file, check dimensions, review magnification, and save a thumbnail.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Training Tiles
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a histolab tile extraction plan for model training. Compare random, grid, and score-based extraction for my slide set and suggest parameters.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Tissue Masks
prompt_templates.prompt: My tissue mask misses valid tissue and includes artifacts. Help me adjust histolab filters, thresholds, and mask choices for better extraction.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Slide Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a repeatable histolab workflow for many slides. Include inspection, mask preview, tile extraction, quality checks, reports, and storage considerations.

output_examples.input: Plan random tile extraction from one prostate whole slide image for model training.
output: Recommended random sampling with fixed seed, tissue checking, and consistent tile size.
Suggested previewing tile locations before extraction and saving thumbnails for review.
Included quality checks for background content, artifacts, and output consistency.

output_examples.input: Troubleshoot a tissue mask that excludes valid tissue.
output: Suggested reducing small object removal thresholds and reviewing dilation settings.
Recommended comparing the default largest-tissue mask with a full tissue mask.
Added a visual review step before any large extraction run.

output_examples.input: Compare tiler choices for a whole-slide analysis project.
output_examples.output: Random tiling was recommended for sampling, grid tiling for complete coverage, and score-based tiling for selecting the most informative regions.

best_practices: Preview thumbnails, masks, and tile locations before running large extractions.
Use fixed seeds and consistent levels when creating reproducible datasets.
Validate extracted tiles for tissue coverage, artifacts, blur, and storage impact.
anti_patterns: Do not extract at full resolution before confirming memory and storage limits.
Do not assume default masks work for every stain, scanner, or artifact pattern.
Do not use generated tiles for clinical decisions without expert validation.

faq.question: Does this skill diagnose disease from pathology images?
faq.answer: No. It helps prepare and inspect image processing workflows, but it does not provide medical diagnosis.

faq.question: Which slide formats are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance focuses on formats commonly used with histolab and OpenSlide, including SVS, TIFF, and NDPI.

faq.question: Can it help create machine learning datasets?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help plan tile extraction, tissue filtering, quality review, and repeatable dataset preparation.

faq.question: Does it include the histolab Python package?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance. You must install histolab and its dependencies in your own environment.

faq.question: Can I use it with protected health information?
faq.answer: Use local approved workflows and follow your organization rules for sensitive medical data.

faq.question: Can it tune masks for unusual stains or artifacts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest filter and mask adjustments, but results should be validated on representative slides.
